duo.title: Neuropet – Neuro-sama & Evil Neuro Screen Pets (Fan-made HUD Mascots)

addon_description.en: Between zombie fights, tiny Neuro-sama and Evil Neuro roam, climb and rest around your screen. Sometimes they tumble; sometimes one goes looking for the other. A little hug, then off they go again.
addon_description.zh-CN: 打僵尸的间隙，小小的 Neuro-sama 和 Evil Neuro 一起住进了屏幕边缘。她们各自走走、爬爬、挂着休息，偶尔跌落或绊一跤。有时，一只会去找另一只，停下来抱抱，再各自出发。
